items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Eddie Pearson was our first drummer player... He was playing drum over us.

ctx.x: I used to go to rehearsal with him, and I said, Peter, and you have to talk to him next to the speakeasy where I was playing at night, by Zanko. Yeah. Right next to his house. Yeah.
That's what I did. You know who used to come in our house and practice a lot, too? Uh, he's dead now. Eddie, um... I remember the last husband.
